name: package-counter
description: GNOME Shell extension that displays the number of available package updates
author: xorsirenz

scripts.install: npm run build && npm run install-schemas && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions" && ln -sfn "$PWD" "$HOME/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/package-counter@xorsirenz.dev" && gnome-extensions enable package-counter@xorsirenz.dev
scripts.reload: gnome-extensions disable package-counter@xorsirenz.dev && gnome-extensions enable package-counter@xorsirenz.dev
